map.休闲挑战：记录猜测次数与最佳成绩，练信息利用效率。: Casual challenge: record the number of guesses and your best score to train efficient use of information.
map.因为 2^7=128>100，每步砍半 7 次足以区分 100 个数；这是信息论: Because 2^7=128>100, halving seven times is enough to tell 100 numbers apart; this is the information-theoretic lower bound, so a rational player always wins within 7 steps.
map.提示「大了/小了」之外有更优反馈吗？: Is there better feedback than "too high" / "too low"?
map.有就退化成 1A2B 类；本游戏只给大小，故二分法是最优策略，无需更复杂反馈。: If it did, it would degenerate into a 1A2B style; this game only reports higher or lower, so binary search is the optimal strategy and no more complex feedback is needed.
map.每次猜区间中点：1–100 先猜 50；若提示「大了」则缩到 1–49 猜 25: Each time guess the midpoint of the interval: for 1-100 start with 50; if told "too high" narrow to 1-49 and guess 25, otherwise narrow to 51-100 and guess 75; halve the interval each round. The worst case is ceil(log2(100)) = 7 steps to be certain ...
map.算法教学：演示二分查找的最坏步数 ⌈log2(100)⌉=7，理解「每次砍半」的: Algorithm teaching: demonstrates the worst-case step count of binary search, ceil(log2(100))=7, and shows why halving each time is so efficient.
map.逻辑游戏：系统在 1–100 随机选数，每次猜后给「大了/小了」提示，用二分法最: Logic game: the system picks a random number from 1-100 and replies "too high" / "too low" after each guess; find it in the fewest steps with binary search.
